failure.measured: 8 of 8 sampled rows carry checkoutDigest === expectedPrefix but NO installedDigest (JSON omits the undefined field), so `matches` is false for every row

rootCause.statement: ENVIRONMENT-dependent, not wave-caused: resolveHostRoot() resolves the `dsh-tui` launcher on PATH (the 0.14.0 GLOBAL nvm install created 2026-10-08T01:19:43Z), whose root carries no `dsh-ecosystem-spec/` directory, while the pinned SPEC_ROOT checkout does. verifyCrossCheckIdentity() therefore reads installedDigest === undefined and every row fails.
rootCause.resolveHostRootRule: DSH_TUI_ROOT first, else dirname(dirname(realpath(<dsh-tui on PATH>))) — skills/dsh-qa/scripts/lib/tui-lane.ts
rootCause.resolvedHostRootMeasured: /root/.nvm/versions/node/v24.16.0/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui (has dsh-ecosystem-spec: false; entries: LICENSE README.md assets bin cordis.patch.yml cordis.yml guide lib node_modules package.json presets tui-profile vendor)
rootCause.whyNotWaveCaused: The failure reproduces with the wave's edits absent from the case's inputs (case .ts unmodified, dsh-plugin.json unmodified, tree clean when the sweep started) and reproduces with MPD_E2E_TUI_VERSION unset.
